items.title: eBay (EBAY) Faces Softer Growth And Rising Costs, Is The Recent Run Already Priced In?
items.summary: Recent concerns about eBay (EBAY) center on modest active buyer growth, soft sales trends, and costs rising faster than revenue. These factors are weighing on profitability and raising questions about how effectively management is using free cash flow. Over the past year, eBay’s share price has risen, with a year to date share price return of 21.76% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 13.44%.
